div.h1: What each node puts on the row
div.p:
The tool step is three nodes.
The coverage verdict rides an edge.
The rewrite is not built.

g.text: What can be read, and what cannot

text.tspan: Tracing reads these fields, it does not replace them.
Closing condition: the outcome breakdown by hop and node
is read from the record, not from a series of SQL queries.
call the LLM with the tools this hop is allowed
our dispatch; raw results to the state,
read each chunk, drop the foreign ones;
off by default, then a pass-through
not a tool the model calls
ask the corpus again in other words
metrics.asks with a verdict per chunk,
With the judge: A/B against single_shot,
Without a judge: the grader against
the corpus leg would stop being
a tool call, where the template limit bites

g.text: each would have written its decision
and only then can these be read
